title: A Group Chat for the Playlist
author: Hazel Ravensworth
blurb: Lena Vane, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
